learned: 2026-10-15: a Webflow page of flower COAs, PDFs on Webflow's CDN. Lab: Keystone State Testing (terpenes); cannabinoids are a subcontracted lab's COA attached as pages the reader does not parse.
notes: Filenames are <webflow id>_<lab order>_<Strain_Name>_<lab sample #>.pdf, or <id>_<Strain_Name>_Certificate_of_Analysis.pdf.
The lot is the report's Regulator Batch ID (CR-PP-10-ST-1); the Metrc tag is its Regulator Sample ID.
